approach: Power radiated by a black body is proportional to its exposed surface area, so compare the hemisphere's curved and flat surface to the whole sphere's surface.

steps.text: Write the total surface area of the sphere.
Write the exposed surface area of one hemisphere after the cut, including the flat circular face.
steps.why_this_step: Once the sphere is cut, the flat circular face is no longer touching the other half, so it also radiates.

steps.text: Take the ratio, since radiated power at a fixed temperature is proportional to surface area.

common_mistakes.text: Comparing intensity (power per unit area) instead of total power, which is 1:1 since both surfaces are at the same temperature, ignores that the hemisphere has less total area than the sphere.
Counting only the curved surface of the hemisphere and forgetting the flat circular face exposed by the cut gives 2πr² against 4πr², or 1:2.
